decisions.reason: The award-winning fruit-puree yogurt is close to the core yogurt business, but it has not been seen on the website since 2018, which suggests weaker support and a moderate risk of being dropped.
The Abendbrotkäse was positioned as a flagship of the cheese direction, so the firm is likely to keep it despite less visibility on the website.
A basic semi-hard cheese wheel is a staple of an organic cheese range and has low cost to maintain, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The spicy cheese line may lose individual variants, but the line as a whole probably stays in the range.
The washed-rind soft cheese is a niche item with higher delisting risk, and Product E has already been cut from the soft cheese range, but it is likely to get one more year.
